dedupeText: vintage folk rock concert aesthetic 1960s folk rock grainy film stage lighting psychedelic typography halftone pattern dark negative space at the top and bottom framing the central figures high contrast stage lighting creating sharp highlights against deep shadows juxtaposition of clean thin header type with heavy textured footer type warm skin tones and saturated stage attire against a pitch black background combine a grainy high contrast live performance photo with a dual typography layout clean condensed sans serif on top and heavy textured colorful geometric type on the bottom

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast live performance photograph featuring four musicians on a dark stage, framed by clean sans-serif header text and bold, textured footer typography with a vibrant color gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark negative space at the top and bottom framing the central figures
High-contrast stage lighting creating sharp highlights against deep shadows
Juxtaposition of clean, thin header type with heavy, textured footer type
Warm skin tones and saturated stage attire against a pitch-black background
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and analog noise
Deep black background with no visible stage floor
Primary-colored accents in the bottom typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Mid-shot of four performers arranged horizontally across the center, varying in depth and profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central female figure in a dark red dress, positioned slightly off-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the clean white header, move down through the performers' faces and instruments, and land on the heavy, colorful footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space at the top and bottom to accommodate large-scale typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multi-color gradient (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green) in footer text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between subjects and background; high saturation in the footer graphic elements.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure white; use cream or light grey for highlights

letterConstructionRules: Header: Uniform stroke weight, high x-height, condensed proportions
Footer: Extra-bold geometric slab, heavy weight, wide stance
characterSpecificRedesigns: Footer letters feature internal halftone and wavy line textures
Footer letters utilize a spectral color transition from left to right
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a light, airy header and a heavy, textured footer.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, vertical feel of the header text.
Provides the necessary weight and geometric structure for the footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1960s style film photograph of four folk-rock musicians performing on a dark stage. High contrast, heavy grain, warm stage lighting. The top and bottom thirds of the frame should be solid black negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a condensed white sans-serif title in the top black area. Add a massive, extra-bold geometric title in the bottom black area, filled with a red-to-green gradient and a halftone texture.

verificationChecks: Is there visible film grain on the subjects?
Does the bottom text have a textured, multi-color fill?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the performers

avoid: Flat, solid colors in the footer text

postGenerationChecks: Check for 1960s era-appropriate clothing and hairstyles
Ensure the grain is uniform across the image
Verify the text is legible against the black background
Confirm the halftone texture is visible in the footer text
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grainy, high-contrast live performance photo with a dual-typography layout: clean condensed sans-serif on top and heavy, textured, colorful geometric type on the bottom.
